rejection_reasons.observation: The automatically generated eth0 profile installed a lower-metric default route through the isolated USB maintenance link, overriding the valid Wi-Fi default route and preventing DNS, HTTPS, SIP, OTA, and maintenance verification.
The kernel could not load rtl_nic/rtl8153a-4.fw for the installed RTL8153 adapter.
systemd-tmpfiles rejected root-owned content paths below a recursively millennium-owned persistent parent as unsafe path transitions.
RuntimeMaxSec terminated the helper while connectivity verification was blocked; Restart=on-failure then reopened setup repeatedly instead of enforcing the hard 15-minute limit.
The Python URL probe did not bound resolver latency at the process level, allowing an accepted owner attempt to reach the service deadline before rollback completed.
